tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the skills library by task, tool or problem, for example "GA4 unassigned traffic", "UTM convention for paid social", "Meta CAPI dedupe" or "HubSpot implementation order". Returns skill names with a one-line summary, practice area and access level. Use get_skill next to read one.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Return one skill as Markdown: when to use it, inputs, procedure, acceptance checks, boundaries and live docs to check. Pass file to read one of the skill's reference, asset or script files, using the relative path the skill links to (for example "references/destination-mapping.md").

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List every skill in the library by practice area, with a one-line summary and access level, plus how many more are in review.
